graduation_criteria.description: Discovery → Deployment 전환 조건. discovery_graduation_gate.sh 강제. v8.x WS2 재설계(2026-05-29): rank-IC 계열은 long-only 실현 alpha와 어긋나(16후보 calibration 실측: rank_ic가 FLOW 거짓탈락+NN/TECH 거짓통과) advisory로 강등, portfolio-alpha t(forge NW lag-3)를 hard로. DSR hard는 sweep형 selection만(2026-06-10 개정 — chain/단일은 advisory). hard 기준은 forge-authoritative 값(alpha-stage proxy 아님)에 적용.
graduation_criteria.min_rank_ic_rationale: KR top-universe benchmark. <0.04는 IC 약함. (v8.x severity=advisory — long-only 실현 alpha 미전이)
graduation_criteria.max_drawdown_days_rationale: 100일 이상 drawdown 지속 시 alpha decay 의심. (severity=advisory)
graduation_criteria.min_harvey_t_stat_rationale: rank-IC Harvey-t. (v8.x severity=advisory — rank-IC t는 portfolio-alpha t와 구분, 후자가 권위)
graduation_criteria.min_deflated_sharpe_ratio_rationale: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR — multi-testing 보정 SR. (severity=HARD는 sweep형 selection만 — ML스윕/optimizer서치/앙상블·사전등록 grid. 가설주도 chain/단일검증은 advisory 강등+진단산출. 도훈 mandate 2026-05-31/2026-06-10, measurement-graduation §3)
graduation_criteria.min_portfolio_alpha_t_nw_rationale: ★v8.x 신규 HARD. forge-authoritative 실현 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3, forge_package.portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 hurdle. rank-IC t 아님. 게이트 핵심 판별(16후보 중 FLOW만 통과=정확).
graduation_criteria.severity_rationale: hard = block(우회불가), advisory = warn(screening). hard 2종(DSR/portfolio_alpha_t_nw)은 forge-authoritative 값에만 적용 — alpha-stage proxy로 graduation 선언 금지(v8.x WS1 정합).

hypothesis_description:
FROM momentum-hunt backlog (kr-novel-momentum-hunt), ranked #1-by-scorer / #2-build. NON-return-derived. FULL build-ready spec at stage_artifacts/momentum_hunt/backlog.json -> specs[name='Quiet Accumulation (Flow-Price Divergence)']. READ IT and follow build_steps.

CONCEPT: QA_t(i) = z_flow_t(i) - beta_t * z_priceresp_t(i), where beta_t = expanding no-intercept OLS (LAGGED, INV13 accumulator pattern, compute_investor.R). flow leg = frollsum(Foreign+Institutional, LB)/Size (smart-money net-buy, non-return); price-response leg = return over same LB (subtracted out). Signal = the flow that is NOT explained by contemporaneous price move = 'quiet accumulation' (informed buying under a flat tape, inelastic demand not yet priced).

WHY NOW / DIRECT FOLLOW-UP TO C21: WT-D20260621_003 (C21) just found smart-money flow LEVEL has NO standalone forward edge in KR top-20 long-only (M_flowOnly PORT_t -0.638). This concept is the decisive test of WHETHER flow carries edge ONCE the price-response confound is residualized OUT. If QA also fails, the 'flow level' axis is well-characterized (still one more data point, NOT a limit).

GRID: LB in {21d,42d,63d} x flow in {Foreign+Inst, Foreign-only}, top_n=20. burn-in 60m. Anchor = LB42/F+Inst.

ORTHOGONALITY (active -BM basis): M01/12-1 momentum (price leg SUBTRACTED -> structural anti-corr expected, target |corr|<=0.30, negative allowed = mechanism evidence, directly attacks spanning), INV01/INV02 raw Foreign flow (|corr|<=0.55 else price-removal pointless), INV13 Foreign_Resid_Individual (same accumulator different X-leg, |corr|<=0.50), Size/low-vol (small-cap accumulation bias check, |corr|<=0.40).

HONEST RISK (per spec + AX-000 amended): (1) price-residualization may KILL the signal -- KR long-only shares market beta ~0.99 (memory S6); removing the price leg may strip market component and leave no active alpha. CRITICAL: INV13 (this concept's base accumulator) ITSELF did not graduate (16/16 PORT_t FAIL cohort) -- 'orthogonal != profitable' (measurement-graduation S6). orthogonality_potential high does NOT guarantee PORT_t. (2) flow-price simultaneity interpretation. Graduation NOT presumed; real-but-non-graduating -> screen-route. This is concept #2 of an ongoing exhaustive campaign -- a negative is one data point, never a 'structural limit'.

PIT/CONSTRAINTS: beta = expanding no-intercept OLS LAGGED state only (C1, no full-sample); cross-sectional z per sig_date self mean/sd (no full-sample stats); investor Date<sig_date strict; Size t-1; price LB window pre-sig_date (C2); long-only ONLY; KR; max 25; [0,0.20]; 15bps; prod liquidity 2e8. real-computation (canonical_screen_bt) ONLY; Codex Critic Round mandatory. rawdata BM_Ret empty -> .cache/benchmark.parquet.
